highlights: Porodo Two-Device Connect Handheld Lavalier Microphone is a multi-purpose sound solution for industry professionals and content creators.
Its 2.4GHz wireless transmission enables it to support low-latency, high-definition audio with a frequency of 20Hz-20KHz and a sensitivity of 90dB.
The receiver and microphone are powered by 3.7V, 400mAh batteries that run 10-12 hours and have a range of 15-30m guaranteed.
It supports digital cameras, camcorders, Android, and iPhone through its Type-C and 3.5mm jack connectors.
It has a dual-channel receiver that supports two devices at once with the added convenience of automatic noise reduction and ≥75dB S/N ratio for crystal clear sound.
It has a 300mv maximum audio output and ±10PPM frequency stability to provide reliability in performance.
Easy to charge with DC 5V/1A Type-C input, this microphone is ideal for live streaming, interviews, or vlogging, featuring professional-grade sound in a portable, lightweight design.
